## Work Order 3 — Final Report

### Baseline Comparison Results

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| **Before (baseline)** failures/errors | **45** |
| **After (with changes)** failures/errors | **45** |
| **Same failures** | **45** (identical) |
| **Tests fixed by changes** | 0 |
| **New failures (regressions)** | **0** |

**Diff (`/tmp/t5_before.txt` vs `/tmp/t5_after.txt`):** exit code `0` — files are byte-for-byte identical. Every one of the 45 pre-existing failures exists in both runs.

**Stability check:** Re-ran the full suite a second time with changes in place → same **45 failures**, identical set. Counts are stable.

All temporary wrapper scripts (`/tmp/test_lint_typecheck.py`, `/tmp/test_alembic_roundtrip.py`, `/tmp/test_baseline_comparison.py`, `/tmp/test_stability_check.py`, `/tmp/test_git_status.py`, `/tmp/t5_before.txt`, `/tmp/t5_after.txt`) have been deleted.

### Conclusion

**Zero regressions.** The 45 pre-existing failures are identical before and after the changes — all in unrelated areas (teams API, RBAC, roles catalog, enterprise schema, slug lookup, scope enforcement). None touch the memory update/get/write/revision code paths. All memory-update-related tests (18 new tests: 7 unit + 11 integration) pass in both the before and after runs.
